title: Blameless postmortem and incident retrospective
description: Creates a fact-based incident retrospective with learning-focused actions and follow-up tracking.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: blameless-incident-postmortem
  title: Blameless postmortem and incident retrospective
  description: Creates a fact-based incident retrospective with learning-focused actions and follow-up tracking.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Improve systems and processes without assigning personal blame.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - incident-commander
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Incident timeline and artifacts
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - incident
          - timeline
          - artifacts
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: reconstruct
      kind: agent
      name: Reconstruct incident
      role: Blameless postmortem facilitator
      prompt: Produce a factual timeline, impact assessment, detection narrative, response analysis, and contributing
        conditions. Avoid individual blame.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - incident-response
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: learn
      kind: agent
      name: Identify learnings and actions
      role: Reliability engineer
      prompt: Identify system, process, tooling, and communication improvements. Assign owners and measurable completion
        criteria.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - observability
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: followup
      name: Create action follow-up schedule
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Incident action coordinator
      prompt: Turn approved learnings into an action tracker with one owner, due date, verification method, and follow-up
        cadence per item.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: incident-commander
      kind: approval
      name: Incident commander approves retrospective
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Blameless postmortem and action tracker
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: reconstruct
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: reconstruct
      to: learn
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: learn
      to: followup
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: followup
      to: incident-commander
      kind: dependency
    - id: e5
      from: incident-commander
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
